footer: Automated message from the Hoa Huy Supplier Portal. Please do not reply.

invite.subject: Hoa Huy: invitation to activate your Supplier Portal account
invite.body:
Hello {name},

You have been invited to the Hoa Huy Supplier Portal for {supplier}.
Use the link below to set your password (valid for {hours} hours):
{link}

otp.subject: Hoa Huy: verification code {code}
otp.body:
Hello {name},

Your verification code is {code}. It expires in {minutes} minutes.
Do not share this code with anyone.

reset.subject: Hoa Huy: reset your Supplier Portal password

newDevice.subject: Hoa Huy: sign-in from a new device
newDevice.body:
Hello {name},

The account {email} just signed in from a new device (IP {ip}, at {time}).
If this was not you, change your password now via "Forgot password" and tell your company admin.

lockedUser.subject: Hoa Huy: account temporarily locked
lockedUser.body:
Hello {name},

Your account is locked for {minutes} minutes after repeated wrong passwords. If this was not you, reset your password via "Forgot password".

lockedAdmin.subject: Hoa Huy: an account was temporarily locked
lockedAdmin.body:
Hello {name},

The account {user} ({email}) of your company has been locked for {minutes} minutes after repeated wrong passwords.
